6012.reason: MCC 6012 (Financial Institutions – Merchandise and Services) — financial-institution merchandise/services, including debt repayment, carry elevated compliance and chargeback risk typical of financial-services-adjacent merchants.

6051.reason: MCC 6051 (Non-Financial Institutions – Foreign Currency, Money Orders and Travelers Cheques) — quasi-cash instruments carry elevated money-laundering and chargeback-fraud risk.

6211.reason: MCC 6211 (Security Brokers/Dealers) — regulated securities brokerage carries elevated compliance/licensing risk and high-value transactions.
